display_name: Revised Universal Soil Loss Equation screening estimate
equation_text: A = R * K * LS * C * P

source_references.title: USDA NRCS Revised Universal Soil Loss Equation guidance

limitations: Returns long-term average annual soil loss for scalar screening.
Does not estimate event sediment yield, channel routing, deposition, receiving-water concentration, exposure, or risk.
applicability_note: Use RUSLE for erosion susceptibility or gross soil-loss screening when explicit R, K, LS, C, and P factors are available.
